params.val: this hit did not cause the holder to faint

cleared the instant the user takes its next action — not a turn count; using Destiny Bond again just re-applies it fresh. Also verified via Showdown source: only triggers when the faint is caused directly by an opposing move this same hit (effect.effectType === 'Move'), not by residual/indirect damage (poison, weather, hazards, etc.), and explicitly excludes future-sight/doom-desire-type moves (the 'futuremove' flag).
